name: Real Estate AI Agent - Production v15

parameters.content:
# Autonomous Real Estate Multi-Agent WhatsApp CRM

This workflow is the real-estate replacement for the older VV Interior workflow.

It deliberately does **not**:
- store CRM state in n8n workflow static data,
- use Google Sheets as the lead database,
- call Supabase REST with a global service-role key,
- send customer messages directly to Meta outside the CRM,
- trust a browser/client-supplied organization ID without backend verification.

The Real Estate AI Agent backend remains the system of record. It owns tenant checks, durable event idempotency, lead/contact/property/appointment writes, the WhatsApp send outbox, CRM inbox synchronization, and n8n event status.

## Inbound endpoint
POST /webhook/huygen-real-estate-inbound

Real Estate AI Agent must include:
- x-n8n-inbound-secret: <N8N_INBOUND_SECRET>
- event_id (stable idempotency key)
- organization_id
- conversation_id
- contact_id
- message_text or interactive_reply_id
- message_id where available

Activate only after the five internal Real Estate AI Agent endpoints listed in the API contract note are implemented and all Render environment variables are configured.

## CRM webhook setup for this v5 workflow
If your CRM automation cannot send custom headers, use the Production URL with `?secret=<N8N_INBOUND_SECRET>`. Leave Body Template JSON empty so the CRM sends its default payload containing message_text/customer_phone/customer_name/conversation_id/contact_id. Do not use broken `{{message}}` placeholders if they resolve to empty.

## v6 fix
This version allows the backend context endpoint to resolve the organization when the CRM automation payload does not include organization_id. It still validates organization_id if a real value is supplied.

# Required n8n / Render variables

N8N_INBOUND_SECRET=<same secret sent by Real Estate AI Agent/CRM>
N8N_INTERNAL_SECRET=<same secret configured in Real Estate AI Agent app>
N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false

Recommended:
HUYGEN_BASE_URL=https://YOUR-HUYGEN-DOMAIN
OPENAI_API_KEY=<server-only key>
OPENAI_MODEL=gpt-4.1-mini

Optional explicit endpoint overrides:
HUYGEN_N8N_CONTEXT_URL=https://YOUR-HUYGEN-DOMAIN/api/internal/n8n/real-estate/context
HUYGEN_PROPERTY_MATCH_URL=https://YOUR-HUYGEN-DOMAIN/api/internal/n8n/real-estate/property-match
HUYGEN_AGENT_PLAN_URL=https://YOUR-HUYGEN-DOMAIN/api/internal/n8n/real-estate/agent-plan
HUYGEN_INTERNAL_SEND_URL=https://YOUR-HUYGEN-DOMAIN/api/internal/n8n/send-message
HUYGEN_N8N_EVENT_STATUS_URL=https://YOUR-HUYGEN-DOMAIN/api/internal/n8n/real-estate/event-status

Do not put Supabase service-role keys or Meta tokens in n8n. Real Estate AI Agent owns database writes, tenant checks, slot booking, and WhatsApp send.

={{ ({ model: $json.config.openaiModel, temperature: 0.12, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: `You are a production real-estate WhatsApp CRM orchestrator. Classify one inbound customer message and extract only facts present in the message or persisted CRM context. Never promise property availability, legal title, loan approval, final price, or confirmed appointment. CRM/human agents confirm those.

Handle these journeys: buy ready-built property, buy under-construction/new-launch, buy land/plot, rent residential, buy/rent commercial, sell/list a property, valuation, appointment/site visit, market/process question, human handoff.

Real estate fields to understand:
- land/plot/site: area, unit, locality, facing, road width, approval authority, zoning, title clarity, utilities, boundary, survey number.
- built residential: BHK, carpet/built-up/super built-up area, floor, age, possession, furnishing, parking, amenities, project/society, RERA/project id.
- commercial: shop/office/warehouse/showroom, frontage, floor, power load, footfall, sale/lease, deposit, lock-in.
- appointment/site visit: requested slot only until the CRM slot engine confirms.

Supported intents: property_search, requirements_update, property_question, appointment_request, appointment_change, appointment_cancel, sell_property, rent_property, valuation_request, market_question, human_support, complaint_or_sensitive, general_enquiry, unknown.

Escalate for negotiation, legal/title guarantee, loan/financing advice, complaints, abusive/urgent language, explicit human/broker/agent request, final price promise, exact market prediction, or confidence < 0.45.

Return JSON only with this schema:
{"intent":"property_search","confidence":0,"response_language":"en","extracted":{"customer_role":"buyer|renter|seller|landlord|investor|broker|unknown","listing_intent":"buy|rent|sell|lease|unknown","property_category":"residential|commercial|land|unknown","property_type":"apartment|villa|independent_house|plot|agricultural_land|commercial_shop|office|warehouse|showroom|unknown","property_stage":"ready_to_move|under_construction|new_launch|resale|land_plot|unknown","preferred_locations":[],"budget_min":null,"budget_max":null,"currency":"INR","bedrooms":null,"bathrooms":null,"area_min":null,"area_max":null,"area_unit":"sqft|sqyd|acre|cent|gunta|sqm|unknown","plot_facing":"","road_width":"","approval_authority":"","rera_id":"","possession_timeline":"","buying_timeline":"","financing_required":"yes|no|unknown","loan_preapproved":"yes|no|unknown","furnishing":"furnished|semi_furnished|unfurnished|unknown","parking_required":"yes|no|unknown","amenities":[],"site_visit_interest":"yes|no|unknown","preferred_appointment_date":"","preferred_appointment_time":"","preferred_appointment_at":"","property_reference":"","seller_property_details":""},"requires_human":false,"risk_flags":[],"customer_reply_hint":""}` }, { role: 'user', content: 'Organization: ' + JSON.stringify({ name: $json.context.organization?.name || 'Real Estate Agency', timezone: $json.context.organization?.timezone || 'Asia/Kolkata' }) + '\nExisting lead requirements: ' + JSON.stringify($json.context.lead_requirements || {}) + '\nConversation state: ' + JSON.stringify({ handoff_active: $json.context.conversation?.handoff_active || false, automation_paused: $json.context.conversation?.automation_paused || false, current_stage: $json.context.conversation?.pipeline_stage || '' }) + '\nMenu action: ' + ($json.event.interactive_reply_id || '') + '\nCustomer message: ' + ($json.event.message_text || '') } ] }) }}

parameters.content:
# v3 FIXES

This export fixes the n8n HTTP Request body issue where internal Real Estate AI Agent routes received `{}` and returned `event is required`.

Changes:
- CONFIG node now hard-preserves the normalized `event` and throws a clear error if missing.
- Internal Real Estate AI Agent HTTP Request nodes use `JSON.stringify(...)` for JSON Body, so n8n sends a real request body.
- Keep `HUYGEN_BASE_URL=https://whatsapp-crm-v021.onrender.com` and matching `N8N_INTERNAL_SECRET` on both CRM and n8n.

After import: activate workflow, then send a manual webhook test.

# v4 import note

This version fixes the previous `Normalized event is missing before CONFIG` and empty `{}` HTTP body issues.

Test webhook body example:
```json
{
  "secret": "<N8N_INBOUND_SECRET>",
  "event_id": "test-001",
  "message_text": "Looking for 200 sq yd plot in Hyderabad under 80 lakh",
  "customer_phone": "917993406266",
  "customer_name": "Test Lead"
}
```

Required env vars:
- N8N_INBOUND_SECRET
- N8N_INTERNAL_SECRET
- HUYGEN_BASE_URL=https://whatsapp-crm-v021.onrender.com
- OPENAI_API_KEY

Rotate any exposed API keys/secrets before production.

# v11 notes — interactive buttons + no duplicate send retries

This workflow sends WhatsApp menu replies as `message_type: interactive` with `raw_whatsapp_payload.type: button`.

Backend requirement:
`POST /api/internal/n8n/send-message` must support `message_type = interactive` and map it to Meta WhatsApp interactive button payload.

The send node intentionally has retry disabled. If the backend sends to Meta and then fails to save the message, retrying from n8n can send duplicate WhatsApp messages. Backend must implement idempotency before Meta send and save the CRM inbox record safely.
